meta.title: TLEMCENYA — Cold-extracted Sigoise olive oil, Tlemcen, Algeria
meta.description: Olive mill in Tlemcen, Algeria. Cold-extracted Sigoise extra virgin olive oil, ≤ 0.8% free acidity, traceable lots. Bulk, flexitank, tin and glass, FOB Ghazaouet.

hero.lede: We press fruit from the Oued Lakhdar hillsides within six hours of picking, and never above 27 °C. What leaves the decanter goes into stainless tanks the same day.

variety.title: Why Sigoise
body: Sigoise is the olive of western Algeria. It grows on the limestone hillsides between Tlemcen and Ghazaouet, where summers are dry and nights are cool. That day-to-night swing concentrates polyphenols instead of diluting them.

Its flesh-to-stone ratio yields 18 to 22% under cold extraction. On the palate: raw artichoke, green almond, a clean bitterness and a pepper that stays in the throat. It holds up to heat and it does not disappear into a vinaigrette.

process.title: From tree to tank
process.lede: Six operations, in order. Each one carries a time or temperature constraint, and that is where the quality of a lot is decided.

steps.title: Picking
steps.body: Pneumatic combs and ground nets. Fruit travels in ventilated 22 kg crates, never in sacks — a sack crushes the olive and raises acidity before it reaches the mill.

steps.title: Intake and washing
steps.body: Weighing, de-leafing, cold-water washing. Every delivery is assigned a lot number that follows the oil all the way to the container.

steps.title: Milling
steps.body: Stainless hammer mill, continuous flow. The paste is formed with as little air contact as the line allows.

steps.title: Malaxation
steps.body: Forty minutes under nitrogen, 26 °C maximum. Run it warmer and you gain yield and lose aroma; we decide for aroma.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.body: Two-phase centrifugal decanter. No added water, so no polyphenols washed out and no olive mill wastewater to treat.

steps.title: Storage
steps.body: Nitrogen-blanketed 12,000 l stainless tanks at 16 °C, in the dark. Packing happens against an order, never in advance.

meta.title: Privacy policy — TLEMCENYA
meta.description: What TLEMCENYA collects, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This document describes exactly what this site does with your data. It is short because the site collects little.

p: TLEMCENYA, National road N7, Tlemcen 13000, Algeria. For any question about your data: export@tlemcenya.dz.
after: Processing is governed by Algerian law no. 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data. If you write to us from the European Union, the GDPR applies to this processing as well.

sections.h: What we collect, and nothing else
p: **If you place an order** (shop page): full name, phone, wilaya, commune, delivery address, and the optional note you add. Plus the contents of your order.
**If you request a quotation** (export page): company, contact name, email, phone, country, format, volume, Incoterm and your message.
That is all. The site asks for no date of birth, no identity document and no bank details — payment is in cash to the courier.

ul: To call you back and confirm the order, the lead time and the delivery charge.
To prepare and deliver the order.
To answer a quotation request and draw up an offer.
To keep a record of a transaction, as commercial law requires.
after: Your data is **never** sold, rented or used for advertising. We will not send you a commercial message without your explicit agreement.

dl.label: Delivered order
dl.value: 10 years — the statutory retention period for commercial records

after: The basket is not kept by us: it stays in your own browser and you can clear it at any time by clearing the site's data.

p: **This site sets no cookies.** None for analytics, none for advertising, none for social networks.

It uses a single local-storage entry (`tly.cart.v1`) to remember your basket between pages. That entry never leaves your device, is never transmitted to us, and cannot identify you: it is strictly necessary for the service you asked for.
If an analytics tool is ever added, this page will be updated and a consent banner will appear before anything is stored.
No data is sent to a third party to display a page: the typefaces are hosted on our own server, and there is no embedded map, no external video and no social network button.
ul: **The courier**, who receives only the name, phone and address needed for the delivery.
**The site host**, which keeps technical connection logs.
**The form delivery service**, where applicable — @to be named once the provider is chosen.

p: If the form is carried by a provider established abroad, your data passes through its servers. The chosen provider and its country of establishment will be named here. While no provider is configured, requests leave through your own mail software and pass through no intermediary.

The site is served over HTTPS, which encrypts everything you type between your device and the server. There is no public database: the site is made of static files, with no administration area and no user account to compromise.
Orders received are kept in an email account protected by a password and two-factor authentication.
You may ask to access your data, have it corrected, have it erased, or object to its processing. Write to export@tlemcenya.dz: we answer within thirty days.
In Algeria you may refer the matter to the national personal data protection authority. If you live in the European Union, you may refer it to your country's supervisory authority.

meta.description: Ordering, prices, cash on delivery, lead times, collection at the mill and claims.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms govern retail sales placed through the shop on this site. Export sales are the subject of a separate written offer and are not governed by this document.

p: TLEMCENYA sells extra virgin olive oil from its own production, packed in five formats. The contents are identical across formats; only the container changes.
Photographs are illustrative. The label on the delivered product governs as to volume, composition and best-before date.
Prices are shown in Algerian dinars, tax included, excluding delivery. Delivery charges are shown separately and confirmed before dispatch.
TLEMCENYA may change its prices at any time; the applicable price is the one confirmed during the call confirming your order.
You build your basket, then send us your details. **Sending the form is not a firm sale.** The sale is formed when we call you to confirm availability, lead time and total amount, and you accept it.
We may refuse or cancel an order in case of unavailability, an obviously incorrect address, or an abusive order.
Payment is made **in cash, to the courier, on arrival**. No online payment is requested, and no bank details will ever be asked of you on this site or by telephone.
You are invited to check the condition of the parcel in front of the courier before paying.
We deliver to all 58 wilayas. Charges depend on the zone and are shown on the « Delivery and payment » section.
Stated lead times run from the confirmation call. They are indicative: a delay attributable to the courier gives no right to compensation, but you may cancel an order not yet dispatched at no cost.
after: @Lead time to be filled in once the courier is chosen.

p: You may collect your order at the mill, on national road N7 in Tlemcen, free of charge. We tell you the collection window by phone. Payment is made on site.
Olive oil is a foodstuff: an opened bottle can be neither returned nor exchanged, except for a defect of conformity.

If the product delivered is damaged, does not match your order, or is defective, report it within **forty-eight hours** of receipt, by telephone or to export@tlemcenya.dz, with photographs. We will replace the product or refund the sum paid, at our option and after verification.
Keep the oil away from light and heat, with the cap closed. TLEMCENYA is not liable for deterioration resulting from unsuitable storage conditions after delivery.
The processing of your data is described in the privacy policy, which forms an integral part of these terms.
These terms are governed by Algerian law, in particular law no. 18-05 of 10 May 2018 on electronic commerce and law no. 09-03 of 25 February 2009 on consumer protection and the suppression of fraud.
In the event of a disagreement we first seek an amicable solution. Failing that, the courts of Tlemcen have jurisdiction.
